responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s deferred diagnostic pipeline from saved warnings to emitted paths. It finds shortest feasible exploded paths to candidate diagnostics, using trimmed and feasible graphs when path feasibility checking is enabled; deduplicates and suppresses weaker reports; builds checker_path event sequences; and prunes or consolidates low-value path detail such as redundant call/return pairs, multi-edge condition chains, and purely intraprocedural function-entry noise before final emission.
same_name_distinction: Implements the deferred-diagnostic workflow declared in diagnostic-manager.h: feasible-path search, path construction, deduplication/suppression decisions, and path-pruning/consolidation heuristics before emission.
